subject: PlaneGeometry
question:
A dark disc with three holes is placed on top of a dial of a watch (see diagram). Then the disc is rotated around its centre. Which numbers can be seen at the same time? <image1>
Choices:
A:4, 6 and 12
B:1, 5 and 10
C:2, 4 and 9
D:3, 6 and 9
E:5, 7 and 12
